hint.flipCard: Your turn. Press s to flip the next card

tutorial.cpuPile: CPU's stock. Remaining count is shown.
tutorial.arena: The center pile. Slap when a pair or sandwich appears.
tutorial.playerPile: Your stock. You lose if it empties.
tutorial.stepButton: Flip the top card of your stock. Face cards (J/Q/K/A) impose a chance battle on your opponent.
tutorial.slapButton: Slap when the top two match (pair) or the top three form a sandwich (X-Y-X). Wrong slaps cost you a card.
